de.abas.eks.jfop

Class FOPException

  • Object
    • Throwable
      • Exception
        • RuntimeException
          • FOPException
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    AbortedException, CommandException, EndCalledException

    public class FOPException
extends RuntimeException
    Upper class of all Exceptions which are thrown into one JFOP by abas ERP. These Exceptions are always the consequence of programming errors or user cancelations which the JFOP programmer permitted. It concerns an Exception which is not to be declared (RuntimeException). Special FOP Exceptions defined in the future will always be sub-classes of this class (except in AJO, which can throw other exceptions such as FieldAccessException). If you do not want to differ between individual Exceptions it is sufficient to catch this Exception class. Each method of the EKSe class could potentially trigger an FOPException. However, this must not be caught; it is notified by abas ERP along with the callstack. If no callstack is required, the FOPExitException must be used which forces an ".error" message.
    See Also:
    FOPExitException, CommandException, AbortedException, Serialized Form
